title: Hierarchical ZIF-67@NiS grown on nickel foam as a high-performance binder-free electrode for electrochemical capacitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19499-19510
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01220E, Paper

Fowzia S. Alamro, Mahmoud A. Hefnawy, Hoda A. Ahmed, Shymaa S. Medany
Hierarchical ZIF-67@NiS grown on nickel foam (ZIF-67@NiS-NiF) was successfully synthesized and evaluated as a binder-free electrode for electrochemical capacitor applications.
